title: A cyclotomic resolution-Betti obstruction for the global canonical index
exact_target: Fix a dimension $n$. For projective $n$-dimensional varieties with log-canonical singularities and numerically trivial canonical divisor $K_X$, is the index of $K_X$ bounded by a constant depending only on $n$? The index is the least positive integer $m$ for which $mK_X$ is Cartier and linearly trivial in the stated canonical-index setting.
